title: AthlyticsMind: A Tailored LLM-based Conversational Agent to Mitigate Stigma and Support Elite Athlete Mental Health

contributions.purpose: 综述精英运动员心理健康与污名机制
contributions.mechanism: 综合流行病学证据与"心理韧性"污名的社会文化机制
contributions.evaluation: 现役运动员焦虑/抑郁患病率约 34%、退役约 26%(引文数据,定性综述)
contributions.domain: 运动心理健康/LLM 对话智能体
contributions.source_quote: We first synthesize the epidemiological evidence on athlete mental health and deconstruct the socio-cultural mechanisms of stigma that deter help-seeking.

contributions.purpose: 提出面向运动员的无污名 LLM 对话智能体架构
contributions.mechanism: 运动专属对话管理+精选知识库,定位为保密、无污名的首触点
contributions.evaluation: 仅概念架构,未实现、未评估(定性)
contributions.source_quote: We present the conceptual architecture of AthlyticsMind, featuring sport-specific dialogue management and a curated knowledge base.

contributions.purpose: 主张人机混合照护模型
contributions.mechanism: 聊天机器人作为通往专业支持的"gateway"桥梁而非替代
contributions.evaluation: 提出未来 RCT 设计(等待名单对照),本文无实证(定性)
contributions.source_quote: Our primary contribution is the proposal of a hybrid human-AI model of care, where the chatbot serves as a crucial, stigma-mitigating bridge to professional support.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This proposal is grounded in a rigorous analysis of emerging research that compares the therapeutic competencies of advanced LLMs with those of human counselors [5].

notes: 纯概念/立场论文:无系统实现、无实验、无用户数据,仅提出架构与未来 RCT(四元组 evaluation 为定性,符合非实证放行)。Checklist AI 自我披露红旗:自认">50% of the text was AI-generated",且"testable hypothesis 与 gateway 概念"由 AI 提出;并披露 AI 在"bibliographic details and citations"上有 hallucination/confident inaccuracy——参考文献可能被污染,数据红旗。desk-reject 型低质。reject。
